summary.headline: Judgments of Wealth and Sustenance
summary.text: Astrological judgment of wealth and sustenance: the lord of the second house, Moon, ascendant lord, Jupiter, Part of Fortune, reception, applications, angles, succedents, and triplicity lords indicate abundance or difficulty in acquiring necessities, with effects differing across the native’s life.
